numbers.evidence: Abstract: "ZR-0 is pre-trained on ProcCorpus-60M, a large-scale dataset comprising approximately 60 million frames (approximately 1,000 hours) from over 400K trajectories, with dense ECoT annotations covering 96.8% of all frames."

ProcCorpus-60M is an existing corpus (ref [22]) that ZR-0 adopts, not one it builds.
